 Today's forecast 
 Get the latest weather updates from the NBC6 meteorologists. 
 By Adam Berg • 
 Published October 27, 2026 • 
 Updated on October 27, 2026 at 7:13 am 
 BOOKMARKER 
 NBC Universal, Inc. 
 NBC6’s Adam Berg has your forecast for today, Tuesday, Oct. 27, 2026.
 Tuesday marks the peak of this King Tide cycle and then things finally start improving on Wednesday. 
 We are currently under a coastal flood warning, a high wind advisory, a gale warning for boaters (seas occasionally hitting 18 feet on Tuesday) and we are expecting dangerous rip currents on top of all of this. Winds dial back over then next day along with rain chances. This combined with lower high tides will make a huge difference.
 Watch NBC6 free wherever you are
   WATCH HERE 
 Looking into Halloween weekend, we could see a few lingering storms, but I think we can all agree we will take a storm or two if we can avoid this brutal flooding.
 Today: Mostly cloudy, passing downpours. Gusty winds continue. 83°
 Wednesday: Breezy, passing downpours. 85°
 Thursday: Partly cloudy, showers around. 86°
 Friday: Partly cloudy, showers around. 86°
